status: M37 animation prototype; not yet assigned to the 50-level campaign
occupancy: Reserve all four cells. No gem or other obstacle may share any reserved cell.
activationPolicy: At most one stage change per activation id per cabinet, even if an area effect touches multiple footprint cells. Golden Seeker child activations have distinct ids.

states.name: Open
states.hitResult: Release exactly one rainlight and decrement remaining goal units by one

states.name: Empty
states.hitResult: Retire footprint and refill once; ignore subsequent hits

animationRules.goalLogic: Update gameplay progress when rainlight release is committed; animate the displayed counter on arrival.
animationRules.refill: Start after final clear reaches its handoff marker; no gem hidden behind the intact cabinet.

notImplemented: Campaign rebalancing for all nine planned families
